subject: reasoning
question: HJKN is related to EGHK in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, QSTW is related to NPQT. To which of the following is IKLO related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is: (3) is subtracted from the position values according to the English alphabetic series.

So,

HJKN is related to EGHK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75df5a33f0ad16034690ba2f097aa964b243b8408487d56c1d5bba7495f52cc2.png] 

And,

QSTW is related to NPQT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e4679f1beff2379ae0513b518ad4aec65b8c03f2e812884608ac436909ec105.png] 

Similarly,

IKLO is related to

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a16308b0130c095272f1661e273969dc5587e89413d25442381677dbf074c2ca.png] 

Hence, "Option - (1)" is the correct answer.
